issues.explanation: The members view shows only ui.members_invite_title and never renders Members of :entity.
The diff adds a full invite flow with no Pest/PHPUnit tests including unauthorized and tamper tests.
openMember reads a membership with no server-side authorization check.
confirmRemoval and cancelRemoval toggle removal UI state without authorization.
inviteEmail, memberRole and other inputs use validate([...]) with no #[Validate] attributes.
selectedMembershipId and confirmingRemoval are client-writable without #[Locked].
A user-facing feature ships with no README, docs, or CHANGELOG update.
isPending, isExpired, scopePending and inviter are added but never used in the diff.

conventions.evidence: Migration has reversible down() and audit logging via Log::channel('audit'); but Livewire uses $this->validate([...]) / validateOnly with no #[Validate], no #[Locked] on selectedMembershipId/confirmingRemoval, and no docs/CHANGELOG update.

readability.evidence:
Small focused methods (sendInvite, accept, decline, openMember, saveRole) with clear names and sibling Blade style; modal header exactly

{{ __('ui.members_details') }}

.

requirements.evidence: Invites table, EntityInvite normalization/casts, factory expired(), EntityInviteMail markdown emails.entity-invite, sendInvite/cancelInvite/accept/decline logic, rate limit 10/hour, modals and lang keys present; but members.blade.php has no 'Members of :entity' title.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves invites/members/modals/mail/lang/routes; addMember/assignRole removed, no unrelated files or features.

security.evidence: Sensitive writes authorize (sendInvite/cancelInvite/saveRole authorize update/assignRole) with validation, race caught as QueryException->addError, {{ }} escaping, LOWER(email) matching; but openMember/confirmRemoval/cancelRemoval call no authorize and server-only IDs are not #[Locked].

simplicity.evidence: Lean reuse of existing audit channel, mail theme x-mail::message, and membership scoping via $this->entity->memberships()->findOrFail; extra unused isPending/scopePending/inviter surface.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ directory changes and no Pest coverage for happy path, validation, unauthorized calls, or tampering.

review.summary: The change implements the invite flow, manager-only members page, modals, mail, and rate limiting with correct edge-case handling. It needs rework before merge because it ships with no tests, misses the Members of :entity title, and leaves UI actions without server-side authorization.
